scope: Equivariant prequantization of the supplied regular split orbit Spin_0(7,7)/MA, with A the connected split Cartan and M its finite compact centralizer.

construction.A: exp(a) isomorphic to R^7 as a Lie group
construction.unitary_character: chi_mu(m exp H)=exp(i mu(H)), trivial on M
construction.invariant_connection_curvature: minus i times the convention-signed KKS form
construction.reason_no_lattice: The connected split torus A is exponential and noncompact; every real linear functional on a integrates to a unitary character through exp(i mu(H)).

claim_ceiling: Exact homogeneous prequantum-character construction for every supplied regular split charge. It imposes no charge lattice and supplies no source selection, polarization Hilbert completion or physical state space.
